---
title: Survival
---

This tutorial uses orthoDr 2.0.0. See [Get Started](get-started.html) for
installation and the complete R script.

```{r load-package, eval=FALSE}
library(orthoDr)
```

```{r guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(rprojroot::find_package_root_file("tools", "pkgdown-guide.R"), local = TRUE)
cat(guide_section("Fit a survival model and predict curves"), sep = "\n")
```

## Next steps

See `orthoDr_surv()` for the forward, counting process, and martingale methods,
and `predict.orthoDr()` for survival prediction. The
[supplemental survival example](../examples/survival-optimizer.R) uses the bundled
melanoma data and shows how to plot training outcomes against a reduced predictor
with `view_dr_surv()`.
